# Little Jem

## Overview

- **Age:** 13  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** The little house by the harbour shore  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v5 c23 P49](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0049)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Jem  <sub>[v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>; Jem Blythe  <sub>[v5 c4 P20](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0020), [v5 c6 P20](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Jem has curly red hair like his mother and frank hazel eyes like his father. He features his mother's fine nose and his father's steady, humorous mouth. He is the only child in the family with ears that satisfy Susan.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)_

## Personality

Jem is a sturdy, reliable, and fair boy who never breaks a promise. He is inquisitive and observant, preferring to test facts scientifically rather than accept them on faith. He does not believe in ghosts and possesses a square and reliable nature. He also enjoys adventure and has a fighter's spirit, longing to experience battle.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c6 P20](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0020), [v5 c17 P22](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0022), [v5 c23 P66](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0066), [v5 c35 P11](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0011)_

## History

Jem was born at the little house of dreams by the harbour shore, the firstborn child of Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe. During his babyhood, Captain Jim Boyd bequeathed him a collection of curios. As he grew up at Ingleside, he became known for his extensive firsthand knowledge of nature and his propensity to test statements experimentally. He maintained a standing feud with the housekeeper Susan over her nickname for him, 'Little Jem'. During his childhood, he frequented Rainbow Valley alongside his siblings and friends, showing special affection for his mother by picking her wild flowers like mayflowers and arbutus. He played games like quoits with Jerry Corcoran and was regarded as the squarest boy in Glen St. Mary, leading to his selection as umpire for the Good-Conduct Club. As he approached age fourteen, he spent his evenings studying in the Ingleside garret for the entrance examination to Queen's Academy. After a final gathering in Rainbow Valley with his companions, he prepared to leave for Charlottetown to attend the academy.

_Sources: [v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 c35 P41](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0041), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 c4 P62](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0062), [v5 c6 P29](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0029), [v5 c8 P12](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0012), [v5 c23 P49](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0049), [v5 c23 P66](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0066), [v5 c26 P25](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0025), [v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)_
